benefit: French marigold (Tagetes patula) root exudates suppress root-knot nematodes when planted as a full-season cover ahead of solanaceae. Interplanted, marigolds attract hoverflies and parasitic wasps that take down thrips and aphids.

members.title: Marigold border at tomato/pepper transplant
members.body: Plant French marigold transplants on the row edges at the same time as solanaceae transplants. Use one marigold per 4 to 6 ft of row.
